# P-256 OR-proof golden vector, emitted by sigma-rs
# (examples/or_p256_vector.rs in the sigma-proofs repo, --features p256).
# OR of two branches: [0] discrete_log P1=x1*G (simulated), [1] DLEQ
# P2=x2*G ∧ Q=x2*H (real, witness x2). Session "or_proof_example".
#
# Batchable Nizk proof = serialize(ComposedCommitment) || serialize(ComposedResponse).
# ComposedCommitment::Or = TAG_OR u8 || len u32-LE || per-branch (recursive;
#   Simple = TAG_SIMPLE u8 || len u32-LE || group elements[33]).
# ComposedResponse::Or  = TAG_OR u8 || len u32-LE || challenges[32]... ||
#   len u32-LE || responses (recursive Simple).
# CDS: the branches' challenges combine to the transcript challenge (sigma-rs
# uses the Threshold/interpolation machinery; reproduce from composition.rs).
#
# COMPLETE OR-VERIFIER ALGORITHM (from composition.rs), ready to implement:
#  - Composed instance (absorbed) = concat of each branch's LinearRelation
#    label, in order (NO composition tag). Here: discrete_log_label(86B) ||
#    dleq_label. See INSTANCE below.
#  - init transcript(protocol_id="sigma-proofs_Shake128_P256", session, INSTANCE).
#  - Deserialize proof = ComposedCommitment::Or || ComposedResponse::Or.
#    ComposedCommitment absorbed via its FULL tagged .encode() (TAG_OR||len||
#    per-branch TAG_SIMPLE||len||points) — not just raw points.
#  - challenge c = squeeze 64B wide-reduce (as usual).
#  - OR = Threshold(1, n): expand_threshold_challenges: degree=n-1 compressed
#    challenges (the ComposedResponse::Or `challenges` list). Points =
#    (x=0,y=c) + (x=i+1, y=compressed_i) for i in 0..n-1. Lagrange-interpolate
#    a degree-(n-1) poly; branch_challenge[i] = poly(i+1) for i in 0..n.
#    threshold_x(i) = Scalar::from(i+1).
#  - Per branch i: linear-relation check with branch_challenge[i],
#    branch_commitment[i], branch_response[i] (Σ resp·G_k == commit + ch·image).
# NEEDS: Scalar::from_u64, recursive proof deserialization, Lagrange interp.
